objective: Record evidence that StellaSora assets can be located, extracted, decoded, and cross-checked for a local StellaGaia fan prototype without claiming Unity development usability.

policy.targetRoute: Extract assets and semantic context, then rebuild local Unity control layers and validate selected candidates.

toolRoutes.role: Unity-like project export, reference graph inspection, prefab/material/animation reconstruction input.
Independent quick export/preview route for textures, sprites, meshes, audio clips, Animator, and AnimationClip assets.
Optional script/type metadata recovery route for MonoBehaviour field semantics and dummy assemblies.
Optional Wwise bank event and TXTP semantic reconstruction route; stronger than direct WEM playback.
Configured audio decode/playback route for WEM and game audio media.

evidenceGroups.label: Local StellaSora source install
evidenceGroups.meaning: The local source install and inventory boundary exist. This does not mean any asset is accepted into the Unity project.

evidenceGroups.label: PC Unity bundle inventory and AssetRipper category exports
evidenceGroups.meaning: PC bundles and several visual categories have extraction/export evidence. This is stronger than a raw file list and weaker than Unity development usability.

evidenceGroups.label: Decoded Wwise audio media
evidenceGroups.meaning: WEM/WAV media can be decoded and selected, with bank/media hints. Unity playback and Wwise event semantics still need separate validation.

evidenceGroups.label: Player/enemy actor extraction candidates
evidenceGroups.meaning: A player and enemy candidate have extraction and reconstruction-route evidence. Animator Controller recovery is a local prototype rebuild route, not original controller restoration.

evidenceGroups.label: Environment module salvage candidate
evidenceGroups.meaning: Rebind04 is the current module-level extraction/reconstruction candidate. It is not proof of full room or original scene recovery.

evidenceGroups.label: UI/reward texture-only rebuild route
evidenceGroups.meaning: Selected UI textures can feed a rebuilt local Canvas/prefab route. Original complex UI prefabs remain high-risk unless separately validated.

evidenceGroups.label: Android package/cache comparison input
evidenceGroups.meaning: Android evidence helps comparison and dependency search. It cannot replace PC/Unity visible validation.

nextAllowedActions: Use this manifest to support acquisition feasibility only.
Do not mark any gameplay asset DevelopmentUsable from this gate alone.
Run the Original Asset Reuse Gate after this gate to decide Unity-focused triage and lane outcomes.
